headline: Power Backup Report for Tom Green County
summary: Homes in Tom Green County face a long outage about once every 10 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 49% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 70 hours. In May 2019, 48% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 13 hours. One Core lasts about 18 hours in August. One Core lasts about 36 hours in March. Two Cores last about 35 hours in August. Two Cores cover 86% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
